newsitem.title: USA: General Cable, SpecTran in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: General Cable, SpecTran in joint venture.

text.p: General Cable Corp and SpecTran Corp have reached an agreement to form a joint venture to develop, manufacture and market fiber optic cable, the companies said Thursday.
General Cable, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Wassall Plc, and SpecTran said in a joint statement they will each own 50 percent in the new company, which will be called General Photonics.
They said the company will initially build upon the products, assets and facilities of Applied Photonic Devices, which was once a wholly-owned subsidiary of SpecTran.

General Photonics will manufacture the full range of fiber optic cable products previously sold under the Applied Photonic name, as well as introduce new products for the fiber optic cable market, they said. Products include industry standard fiber optic cables and accessories, some of which are used for either indoor or outdoor installations in data communications networks, they said.
General Photonics will be based in Dayville, Connecticut and will manufacture fiber optic cable in its Dayville and Danielson, Connecticut facilities, they added.
